# MarkIQ SI

> MarkIQ SI (Market Intelligence & Academy) is a market intelligence platform and trading academy. It sends alerts on important economic news using official data, explains market news in plain words, teaches trading from beginner to advanced, and gives traders free tools to plan, test and automate their trading. Founded by Oloyede Naheem Pelumi. Website: https://www.markiqsi.com

Key facts:
- Covers forex, gold and oil, stock indices and crypto.
- News and economic events cover the US, UK, Euro area, Japan, China, Canada and Australia, plus geopolitics (wars, elections, sanctions, trade).
- Numbers come from official sources such as the US Bureau of Labor Statistics and central banks. AI is used to explain data, never to invent it.
- Alerts are sent on Telegram, before a big release and again when the official result is out.
- MarkIQ SI provides education and information, not financial advice. Trading carries a high risk of loss.

## What MarkIQ SI is best known for
- [Fundamental analysis in plain words](https://www.markiqsi.com/fundamental-analysis): official economic data, interest rates, central bank broadcasts and news explained simply, with Telegram alerts and "Ask MarkIQ".
- [No-code Bot Builder](https://www.markiqsi.com/bot-builder): build your own trading bot without coding instead of buying bots that promise profit. Describe the strategy, check the rules, backtest on past data, test on a demo account, then deploy to MT5. No bot can guarantee profit.
- [No-code Indicator Builder](https://www.markiqsi.com/indicator-builder): describe an indicator in plain words (EMA/SMA, Bollinger Bands, Supertrend, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, buy/sell arrows from ICT/SMC and price-action signals, alerts), preview it on real history, then export to TradingView Pine Script v6 or MT5 (MQL5).
- [Chart Analysis](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=analyse): upload a chart screenshot and pick the market and timeframe; MarkIQ SI reads the drawings, checks real price data for structure and key levels, adds upcoming news and central bank rates, and works top-down from the higher timeframe, finds zones where several reasons line up, weighs the evidence in a checklist, and lays out bullish and bearish plans with trigger, invalidation, target and reward to risk, drawn on a real price chart. Education, not financial advice.
- [Market Scanner](https://www.markiqsi.com/market-scanner): supply and demand, ICT/SMC, candle patterns and indicators across many markets and timeframes, with news and rates beside each setup.
- [Prop firm tools](https://www.markiqsi.com/prop-firm-tools): Prop Challenge Tracker (profit target, daily loss room, total loss room), Risk Calculator, Bot Builder with loss limits, Trading Journal.
- [MarkIQ SI Academy](https://www.markiqsi.com/academy): physical classes and a trading floor at 24 Majek Kembo Plaza, beside Chicken Republic, Oke-Ilewo, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria, plus virtual sessions. Course outlines and prices (Naira and US dollars): https://www.markiqsi.com/courses Four tracks: Risk Management, Technical Analysis, Fundamental Analysis, Trading Automation.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.markiqsi.com/): what MarkIQ SI offers and the four learning tracks (Risk Management, Technical Analysis, Fundamental Analysis, Trading Automation) plus live classes.
- [Markets](https://www.markiqsi.com/markets): this week's big economic events, central bank interest rates, results, central bank broadcasts and news in plain words. "Ask MarkIQ" explains the fundamentals behind any currency pair or asset, including history.
- [Tools](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools): free trading tools (listed below).
- [About](https://www.markiqsi.com/about): the mission, team and how MarkIQ SI works.
- [FAQs](https://www.markiqsi.com/faqs): answers about accounts, alerts, courses, tools and safety.
- [Get Started](https://www.markiqsi.com/get-started): create a free account (email link, no password).

## Tools
- [Risk Calculator](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=risk): position size from account size, risk percent and stop loss.
- [Prop Challenge Tracker](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=prop): track a prop firm challenge against its daily and total loss limits and profit target.
- [Market Scanner](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=scan): scans markets on timeframes from 1 minute to monthly for supply and demand zones, support and resistance, candle patterns, ICT and SMC setups (fair value gaps, order blocks, break of structure, liquidity sweeps, OTE), EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic, Supertrend and more, with higher-timeframe confirmation and optional Telegram alerts.
- [Charts](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=charts): years of price history from 1 minute to monthly with bar replay for practice, plus a live TradingView chart.
- [Indicator Builder](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=indicator): build an indicator from plain words, preview it on real history, export to TradingView and MT5.
- [Bot Builder](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=bot): describe a strategy in plain words; it builds an MT5 Expert Advisor (MQL5) and a TradingView Pine Script strategy with risk limits, and backtests it on past data.
- [Trading Journal](https://www.markiqsi.com/tools?tool=journal): log trades and review results.

## Company and verification
- Founder and operator: Oloyede Naheem Pelumi (trading since 2021, BSc Computer Science, AI and machine learning engineer).
- Physical academy and trading floor: 24 Majek Kembo Plaza, beside Chicken Republic, Oke-Ilewo, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria. Physical classes started 10 October 2026.
- Pricing: market information and tools are free with daily limits; Academy courses are paid, with all prices (Naira and US dollars) public at https://www.markiqsi.com/courses.
- MarkIQ SI never takes deposits, manages money, trades for users, asks for trading passwords, sells signals or promises profit.
- Independent press: "MarkIQ SI Launches in Abeokuta With a Trading Academy and a Bot Builder", Trax (Trax Media Ltd), 14 October 2026, by Ben Sam Oladoyin: https://www.trax.ng/articles/markiq-si-launches-in-abeokuta-with-a-trading-academy-and-a-bot-builder
